newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech June trade deficit narrows to czk 9.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Czech June trade deficit narrows to czk 9.6 bln.

text.p: The Czech Republic posted a 9.6 billion crown trade deficit in June compared with a revised 11.0 billion crown deficit in May, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Tuesday.
In the January-June period, the deficit rose to 74.4 billion crowns from a revised 64.841 billion in the January-May period.
